newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Air Q2 may be hurt by ticket tax.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Air Q2 may be hurt by ticket tax.

text.p: Southwest Airlines Co said Thursday that the return of the federal passenger ticket tax may hurt its second quarter revenue growth.

The 10 percent ticket tax, which was reinstated in early March, was not in effect during last year's second quarter. The absence of the tax allowed airlines to keep funds that normally go to the Federal Aviation Administration.

Southwest also said that that although bookings for the second quarter "are good," it does not expect to match the load factor performance of April 1996. Last April, Southwest said its load factor performance was 64.7 percent.
